name: Campus Diaries
s: Campus Diaries is an MX Original series that will take you back in time to your college years. Given the past few difficult years, there are students who have not been able to enjoy the on-campus college life and the Campus Diaries web series can be a perfect binge watch for them. Directed by Prem Mistry, Campus Diaries is a college drama that narrates some common and some less explored …

paragraphs.text: Campus Diaries is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series directed by Prem Mistry and Abhishek Yadav. The series features Harsh Beniwal, Ritvik Sahore, Saloni Gaur, Salonie Patel, Abhinav Sharma, and Srishti Ganguli Rindani in the lead role. The first season premiered on MX Player on 7 January 2022.
Shaheen Irani of Ottplay gave it a rating of 3.5 out of 5. Pankaj shukla from Amar Ujala gave it a rating 3 out of 5.
